name: Oko
description: Oko is a shapeshifting fae planeswalker and trickster, Oona's first attempt at an heir, the brother of Maralen and the father of Kellan.

He used the raid on Tarnation as a distraction to steal Akul's medallion, then entered the vault, where Vraska betrayed and petrified him as he planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Kellan's mother tells him about his father, Oko, a shapeshifting being from another Realm she met while training and who wanted to raze the town after it shunned her.
timeline.quote: He told me his name was Oko

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan tells Kaya that his father is the fae planeswalker Oko and asks if she knows him.
timeline.quote: His name's Oko

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko, disguised as a city man, approaches Annie on her porch and she sees through his illusion with her golden eye.
timeline.quote: My name is Oko—and your ability to see through illusions is exactly why I've been looking for you.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko offers Annie revenge by recruiting her for a heist against Akul, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko leaves a saloon matchbook and hints that the Hellspurs could easily find her town.
timeline.quote: If it was this easy for me to find you, imagine how easy it will be if the Hellspurs ever decide to come looking.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan hopes someone in Prosperity can tell him about Oko and resolves to meet his father.
timeline.quote: The odds of at least someone in the city having information about Oko were bound to be high.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Unable to sleep after Oko's threat to her town, Annie digs up her buried thunder rifle.
timeline.quote: pulled the lid back to reveal her thunder rifle.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie meets Breeches, Malcolm and Tinybones at the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko is waiting behind the bar.
timeline.quote: "Care for a drink?" Oko's voice sounded from behind the bar.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie agrees to join the crew, but only as far as stopping Akul.
timeline.quote: "I'm in—but only as far as stopping Akul."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko announces the crew will rob Maag Taranau, a vault Annie thought a myth.
timeline.quote: "We're going to rob Maag Taranau," he said at last.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears and explains they hired the crew to break into the vault, which Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
timeline.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko explains that Bertram Graywater holds the key and that the courier Akul chased was a decoy.
timeline.quote: he had Akul halfway across the desert chasing a decoy courier

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko says the first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters, where two team members are imprisoned and the key is held; Rakdos arrives.
timeline.quote: Our first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters,

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Disguised as a courier, Oko enters Sterling Company headquarters carrying a box with Tinybones inside.
timeline.quote: The moment he stepped over the threshold, Oko surveyed the room.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tinybones emerges from the box in Graywater's office and Umezawa finds Oko there.
timeline.quote: Tinybones burst from the lid, partially disassembled.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Umezawa and Oko open a hidden safe behind the portrait and take the sixth key.
timeline.quote: The sixth key.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko, leaving, meets Ral Zarek and Kellan on the road and senses Kellan's fae magic; his illusion collapses.
timeline.quote: Oko stiffened, and his illusion faded away without warning

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko and Tinybones knock out Ral's guard and flee, Oko taking eagle form.
timeline.quote: He shapeshifted into a large eagle

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan tells Oko he thinks Oko is his father, and that his mother is Alyse.
timeline.quote: "I think you're my father."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Sterling guards, Oko is saved when Kellan throws the guards back with golden vine-shaped magic.
timeline.quote: Confusion swirled through Oko's mind until he realized the magic was coming from Kellan.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko decides Kellan should join them, announcing that he is his son, over Vraska's objection.
timeline.quote: Besides, didn't you hear? He's my son.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko decides having a son could be very useful.
timeline.quote: Oko decided that having a son could turn out to be very useful indeed.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko tells Kellan he is glad to have met him and promises to teach him about his heritage.
timeline.quote: Now that we've finally been reunited, I can teach you so much about your true heritage.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan recognizes Ashiok, says they attacked his home and made Rowan Kenrith turn evil, but Oko tells him to trust him instead.
timeline.quote: They made Rowan Kenrith turn—well, evil!

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaervek reports that the artifact is not Thran or Phyrexian, and warns it could unleash another Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: You could be unleashing another Phyrexia on the Multiverse.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan reluctantly agrees to help plan the capture after Oko promises no innocents will be harmed.
timeline.quote: "I promise that no innocents will be harmed."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko, disguised as Sterling guards, ride the train with Umezawa while the rest of the crew watches over a telepathic link.
timeline.quote: The moment Oko's voice pressed into Kellan's mind, he flinched.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises zombies too early, and Sterling guards find Kellan, Oko and Umezawa in the luggage car.
timeline.quote: "She raised the zombies too early," Geralf groaned.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A fight in the luggage car leaves Umezawa wounded and two guards down.
timeline.quote: Oko moved swiftly, freeing a curved knife from his belt.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko overrules Kellan about helping Umezawa and orders Annie to blow up the bridge.
timeline.quote: Oko's jaw tensed. "Take it out."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The bridge explodes but the train does not slow, because the zombies have reached the conductor.
timeline.quote: The explosion was instant, echoing through the train walls and making the floor shake.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko cross the train roof, are attacked by Sterling guards, and are saved by Gisa's reanimated dead.
timeline.quote: Gray rotted arms closed around the guard's shoulders, and her weapon clattered to the ground.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko disguises himself as a guard to lure away Nolan's escorts, and he and Kellan toss them off the train, capturing Nolan.
timeline.quote: give Graywater my regards.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie arrives on Fortune and carries Nolan and Umezawa away from the train.
timeline.quote: Annie steered Fortune toward safety and broke into a fearless gallop

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko jumps off, abandoning the passengers, while Kellan follows and tries to stop the train with his vines.
timeline.quote: He leapt, tumbling across the sand with unsteady grace.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: With a final glance, he turned his back on Kellan and fled for the hills.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan confronts Oko about the plan and Oko reassures him, claiming he trusted him to handle the train.
timeline.quote: you're my son, and I trust you.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: Akul has the other five. He wears them in a medallion around his neck

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko sends Gisa and Geralf to retrieve the map from Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: "Are the two of you up for a little side mission?"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie and Kellan agree to escort Nolan to an oasis so he can make his way home.
timeline.quote: I can go with Kellan and escort the Outcaster to the nearest oasis.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: "I believe this is what you were after."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: We'll split up the team and take a small group of four into the city,

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: Flattery, it seemed, was the key to keeping his son on his side.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: A small crowd jeered and roared, and when one of the axes landed in the other man's chest, the onlookers raised their arms in triumph.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: and used her gaze to turn them to stone.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Twist Fandango and Akul's inner circle capture Oko, Kellan, Annie and Vraska.
timeline.quote: clamping a pair of iron cuffs to his wrists.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Akul mocks Annie about her nephew and says he will watch them suffer.
timeline.quote: How is that nephew of yours?

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: Akul slotted the sixth key into the medallion

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: The duel begins at midnight.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: Oko, Vraska, and Annie appeared, still bound in chains.

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: locked eyes with one after another until all of them were stone.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan retrieves Akul's fallen medallion and tosses it to Oko.
timeline.quote: snatched the key from the ground, and tossed it back through the flames toward Oko's waiting hand.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: instead, Oko turned for the road and left his son behind.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: I brought Kellan with us because I knew he'd get us caught.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: There was no time for a rescue mission tonight.

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: The truth stung more than any wound: Oko had left him behind.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.quote: We get the key back, find the treasure inside the vault, and lock it away on another plane
